facts.fact: WFP Guinea-Bissau says it carries out monthly monitoring of rainy-season conditions, using CHIRPS rainfall, MODIS NDVI and land surface temperature processed in Google Earth Engine, to report vegetation state and flood risk for agriculture.
facts.system: Bulletin de suivi de la saison pluvieuse

facts.fact: WFP Guinea-Bissau states it carries out monthly monitoring of climate conditions and publishes it as a monthly rainy-season bulletin, this issue being August 2025.
